input.heading: Budget
input.text:
### What it costs
Greenbank Contractors quoted £38,400 including VAT to rebuild 400 m of path and stabilize the bank.
The quote is valid for 90 days.
The parish has £5,000 set aside from the 2025 precept.

markdown:
### What it costs
Greenbank Contractors has quoted £38,400, including VAT, to rebuild 400 m of path and stabilize the bank, and this quote remains valid for 90 days. Toward this cost, the parish has £5,000 set aside from the 2025 precept.
